author: /root/policy_standards

source_inspection.shared_rule: One exported closed-mode domain operation; explicit own false requirements and no documents; stored own not_required/empty documents/active lines plus exact canonical order/medicine identity and one projected catalogue batch. Invalid facts fail503; database errors propagate.
source_inspection.type_boundary: Raw boolean|undefined survives pricing; only after shared guard local NonPrescriptionOrderItem[] narrowing supplies false-only computeTotals/persisted flags. No public type/model widening or false default before gate.
source_inspection.effects: Create admission before ensureLinked/reservation/save/funding; enrichment gates before linking/stock/write; both shared payment creators before client/provider/save; manual paid after existing guards and before timestamp/write/queues.
source_inspection.compatibility: Notes-only maintenance and existing capture verification/processing unchanged; cart source untouched. New prescription documents are disabled, including non-Rx attachments. Unknown legacy facts deny new commerce. No role/test/environment bypass.
source_inspection.snapshot: Canonical ID expectation set captured before await; read callback receives a copied ID list. This is not a database version fence.

limitations: No behavior/type/Joi/TypeDI/Mongoose/index/transaction/race/provider evidence from source data checks.
MedicineRepository expands the PaymentService constructor closure; complete current pre-import C3 admission remains required.
Existing issued gateway orders/captures, cached-paid and manual/internal labels/recovery and known source-paid races remain open.
Admission is a read-time check, not a catalogue/order version fence; F1 stays HIGH/open and this does not enable clinical dispensing.
No final integration campaign, module/clinical/financial/security/release acceptance or live effects.
